title: Transaction Records
description: Based on real residential transaction data from the Dubai Land Department (periodic snapshots, not real-time; resale registrations are typically delayed by 4–8 weeks).

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search a community, project or building…

loadFailed: Failed to load data (temporary network/server issue) — this does not mean there are no transactions.
dataStale: DLD hasn't published new sales for {{days}} days (source cadence, not a page error)

trend.title: Last 24 months trend (bars = volume, line = median price)

empty: No transaction data available for the selected filters.
thisProjectIsnT: This project isn’t matched to a DLD development yet.
sourceDubaiLandDepartment: Source: Dubai Land Department — recent records for this development.
emptyRoomsHint: Note: DLD does not record bedroom counts for villas and townhouses (e.g. all DAMAC Lagoons phases), so a bedroom filter excludes those communities entirely.
